description: This file contains a suite of smoke tests for various settings views in a macOS SwiftUI application, testing the construction and rendering of views related to cron jobs, configuration, debug, general, sessions, instances, permissions, about, voice wake, and skills settings.

classes.name: SettingsViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple smoke tests for various settings views.

methods.name: `cron settings builds body`
methods.description: Tests building the body of the CronSettings view with sample cron jobs and log entries.

methods.name: `cron settings exercises private views`
methods.description: Exercises internal/private functions of the CronSettings view for testing purposes.

methods.name: `general settings exercises branches`
methods.description: Exercises different branches in the GeneralSettings for coverage testing.

methods.name: `instances settings builds body`
methods.description: Tests building the InstancesSettings view with sample instance data.
